rules: BLOCKED FROM DIRECT PRIMARY-SOURCE CONFIRMATION THIS SESSION, on 2026-09-13: the German government's own FAQ page (personalausweisportal.de) exists and loaded, but only points to a PDF ('Fotomustertafel') for the actual numbers. That PDF, and a related BMI photo-template PDF, both refused this session's attempts to read them (a direct fetch returned an error on both, and viewing them in a browser triggered a forced file download rather than a page render, which was not accepted). Every number in this file is therefore an unconfirmed, well-corroborated figure from secondary sources, not something read directly from bmi.bund.de by SpecShot.
Commonly cited: 35x45mm, head height 32-36mm (70-80% of frame height) — consistent with the general EU/Schengen ICAO convention documented elsewhere in this library.

CONFLICTING CLAIM, UNCONFIRMED: several sources specifically claim Germany requires a light grey background and does NOT accept pure white, unlike most of its neighbours. This could not be confirmed or ruled out this session. #FFFFFF is used here as a placeholder pending confirmation, not because it's been verified as correct for Germany specifically.

UNCONFIRMED CLAIM: several sources state glasses have been completely banned in German biometric photos since November 2017 (all eyewear, not just tinted lenses) — notably stricter than every other document in this library, which all allow glasses if lenses aren't tinted. Not confirmed against a primary source.

UNCONFIRMED PROCEDURAL CLAIM: several sources state that since 1 May 2025, German ID/passport photos must be captured in person at the registration office or a certified photo service and transmitted digitally — self-submitted photo files are no longer accepted at all. If true, this would affect how (or whether) a browser tool like SpecShot's ID Photo feature is even usable for this document, not just what numbers it targets. Needs confirming before this spec goes anywhere near production.
Do not verify this spec from secondary sources alone — the numbers above need someone to actually open bmi.bund.de's Fotomustertafel PDF directly.
